calls.video_title: Why Is Lam Research Stock Falling, and Is It a Buying Opportunity?
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked LRCX call for Parkevtate (no flip vs calls.json). Upgrades from his 26 Aug stance, when above $300 he said it did not look like a buying opportunity — now at ~$206 after a ~50% fall from ~$450 highs he calls it a buying opportunity for long-term investors: record sales and margins on agentic-AI demand, 30% EPS growth forecast, ROIC 54%, forward P/E 16.8 vs 30% growth (PEG ~0.5).
calls.base_case: Record revenue growth with improving margins; operating margin 37% (trailing 12m), nearly double 2017's 20%; ROIC 54%, 4-5x WACC; analysts forecast 30% EPS growth for several years.
calls.bull_case: Agentic-AI proliferation keeps driving etch/deposition demand; forward P/E 16.8 is near the low end since 2024 vs 40x earlier this year.
calls.bear_case: Investor negativity around all things AI persists; DCF says only fairly valued (~$198 vs ~$206), so the buy case rests on the P/E-vs-growth view, not the DCF.

calls.price_at_call: On crash-buy list; fell ~16% Thursday; 3-yr forecast ~34%/yr; best quarter ever, sales +54%
calls.thesis: BUY, first tracked — on his crash-buy list. Lam Research machines build the tiny circuits inside chips layer by layer, in nearly every big chip fab; more chips = more machines. Risk: ~1/3 of sales from China.
calls.base_case: Chipmakers keep buying etch/deposition tools as capacity grows.
calls.bull_case: AI build-out keeps tool demand high for years.
calls.bear_case: China sales hit by restrictions; chip cycle turns.

calls.price_at_call: forward P/E just shy of 24x on 2027 earnings growth of 65% expected (stated); analyst average target $375, over 50% upside (stated); definite-buy trigger about 22x forward or lower (stated)
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked LRCX call for Mark Roussin (no flip) — stock three of four: Lam Research (captions garble it as 'Lamb Research'). He is increasingly interested after a >10% post-earnings sell-off and says 'if it continues to fall into around 22 times or even lower, I'm definitely buying before 2027.'
calls.base_case: September quarter revenue about $8.2bn, up about 54% YoY, adjusted EPS $2.20, operating margins about 40% — record revenue and profitability; biggest customers Micron, SK Hynix and TSMC are all rushing to add capacity; Edge score 78, shares still up 51% over 12 months.
calls.bull_case: More complex chips need more etching/deposition equipment, so AI chip demand directly creates equipment demand; capacity, not demand, is the bottleneck for its customers.
calls.bear_case: December guidance about $8.6bn disappointed versus expectations; supply-chain constraints may limit near-term shipments, and China was about 35% of September revenue with that share expected to decline significantly in December.
